name: ODU Big Blue Winter 2024
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ODUBigBlueWinter2024#38647-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

All net proceeds will go to [Engineers Without Borders](https://www.ewb-usa.org/), a group of engineers who benefit underserved communities.
